name: ios
description: Epic Startup tenant iOS app (SwiftUI + TenantKit)

scripts.test: if command -v swift >/dev/null 2>&1; then swift test; else echo 'Swift not available, skipping ios tests'; fi
scripts.lint: if command -v swift-format >/dev/null 2>&1; then swift-format lint --recursive Sources Tests; else echo 'swift-format not available, skipping ios lint'; fi
scripts.ios:xcode:build: npm run ios:generate && xcodebuild -project EpicTenantApp.xcodeproj -scheme EpicTenantApp -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' build
